title: Integral elements and integral closure
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings. An element $s\in S$ is *integral over $R$* if it is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in $R$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]: $s^n+\varphi(r_{n-1})s^{n-1}+\dots+\varphi(r_0)=0$ for some $n\ge1$ and $r_i\in R$. The set $S'\subseteq S$ of elements integral over $R$ is a subring of $S$ containing $\varphi(R)$, the *integral closure of $R$ in $S$*. When $R\subseteq S$, $R$ is *integrally closed in $S$* if $S'=R$.
